budget.rationale: Allocate the existing numerical-error fraction of modeled scan-averaged analogue noise to total deterministic numerical field error; no ADC-code matching.
budget.scope: Engineering accuracy allocation under the nominal sensor assumptions, not a probabilistic bound or hardware noise specification.

scope: Independent Biot-Savart quadrature on the curved CAD centerline and the same ideal return path; fixed sensor geometry, all bounded current combinations.
limitations: Reference quadrature convergence is empirical, not a certified remainder bound.
The filament, ideal return path, material and fixed construction assumptions remain shared with production.

regression_tests.scope: After the production Hall-resolution change and before adding the separate recorded-force diagnostic.
